dataset: India State/UT official land-record access directory
publisher: Department of Land Resources and respective State/UT authorities
policy: No owner-by-owner names, personal identifiers, phone numbers or parcel-title records are harvested or bundled. The portal links support lawful, parcel-specific citizen or authorised officer lookups. Bulk integration requires published API terms or an authorised government data-sharing agreement. Coverage in Mizoram and Nagaland is geographically/institutionally limited as described by the competent departments; portal presence is not a guarantee of complete RoR coverage. RBIH/ULI has a documented credentialed single-parcel verification service for a limited State set; this is an authorised on-demand channel, not an open bulk export. DILRMP 3.0 assigns source-data ownership/custody to respective State/UT departments and requires secure APIs subject to applicable law, privacy and security.

records.authority: Government of Meghalaya
records.scopeNote: Government of Meghalaya describes land administration under the Revenue Department and Autonomous District Councils, and states that no uniform State-wide Records of Rights exist. Local customary and council records must be checked with the competent local authority; this entry is not a State-wide searchable RoR portal.

records.authority: Land Revenue & Settlement Department, Government of Mizoram
records.scopeNote: Official department portal provides applications for land allotment, periodic patta, land settlement certificates, ownership transfer and partition. The department describes Mizoram as a non-land-record State with digitisation/modernisation work; an application portal is not a complete statewide RoR or bulk title feed.

records.portalName: Land Records (RoR) / Directorate of Land Records and Survey
records.authority: Directorate of Land Records and Survey, Government of Nagaland
records.scopeNote: Official ROR/digital map portal offers land-record search, digital maps and cadastral details. The Directorate states records exist mainly in Dimapur Mouza, towns, administrative headquarters, Government lands and surveyed pockets; Nagaland land administration also follows tribal customary systems. This is not evidence of a complete state-wide title register.
